sha256-fd-v1:dd19fb809c3db53ad298e3b9864.description: Follow apprentice sorceress Arle through three linked first-person dungeon RPGs at different stages of her life. Spell choices and status conveyed through portraits replace the usual visible statistic display.
sha256-fd-v1:dd19fb809c3db53ad298e3b9864.title: Madou Monogatari 1-2-3

sha256-hdi-v1:dd874cb4e578bc33a2c4155de8.description: Organize a footrace to bring attention to a struggling village. This side-scrolling racing game supports computer opponents and a two-player mode with selectable stages.
sha256-hdi-v1:dd874cb4e578bc33a2c4155de8.title: Run Run Kyousoukyoku

sha256-hdi-v1:dd8b97826e9b6d5fd66f1b4d7e.description: Custom enters nearby dungeons to train for the Battling Gods Championship. Gain experience and equipment through turn-based fights before taking on the tournament.
sha256-hdi-v1:dd8b97826e9b6d5fd66f1b4d7e.title: Toushin Toshi
